messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT detected: p95 latency for hosted inference API spiked to ~1400ms at 2026-03-17T12:04Z. Paging on-call
sre_aly: acked. Oncall ✅ I'll take it. any customer-facing impact?
pm_tom: We're seeing elevated client-side timeouts for a handful of orgs, some 504s from gateway. CS reported 3 customers with degraded UX.
cust_success_lee: one customer (acme-inc) reported responses timing out intermittently, logs show request_id starting with acme-4f...
observability-bot: Alert details: rule=api.p95.latency.hosted > 1000ms; scope=prod-hosted; started=2026-03-17T12:03:50Z; current_p50=220ms; current_p95=1380ms; error_rate+3.2%
eng_jordan: adding traces now. Initial look — p50 barely moved, p95 moved a lot. Sounds like tail work.
eng_runtime_maya: rolling through traces -> spans show token-generation span bursting from 90ms -> 420ms on the tail. Uploading sample spans in thread.
eng_runtime_maya: ```span:generate_tokens id=xyz duration_ms=472
  spans: {kv_cache_lookup: 2ms, attn_forward: 310ms, softmax: 12ms}
  host: host-gpu-12
```
sre_aly: Any infra changes in last hour? kernel or driver updates?
eng_jordan: infra pipeline recorded a kernel patch (linux-6.2.8->6.2.9) rolled to a subset of hosts ~30m ago (canary). Patch note: scheduler tweak + some perf counter changes. I think the canary expanded around 11:55Z.
pm_tom: timeline: 11:50Z canary start, 11:55Z canary expand to 25% traffic, 12:02Z p95 starts to climb.
sre_aly: hypothesis 1: scheduler change increased runqueue latency for our batched GPU workers -> increased token latency on the tail. hypothesis 2: perf counter change disabled a hot path kernel optimization causing syscalls to be slower.
eng_runtime_maya: running `sudo perf stat -e cycles,instructions,cache-misses -p <pid>` on affected host; see elevated cache-misses. snippet:
```perf stat results
  cycles: 3.4e9
  cache-misses: 1.2e7 (-> 2.1x baseline)
```
eng_jordan: pulling kernel dmesg from host-gpu-12: ```[12:01:07] perf: unsupported event 0x3
[12:02:10] cgroup: cpuacct cgroup changed
```
sre_aly: mitigation plan: 1) stop canary kernel rollout and rollback hosts to previous kernel; 2) route high-latency orgs to dedicated capacity if they have it; 3) temporarily enable smaller quantized model fallback for hosted default route.
eng_runtime_maya: initiated rollback for 3 hosts at 12:12Z. also toggled route fallback for default to `redwood/model-quant-small:v2` at 12:14Z for new requests.
eng_jordan: traffic flip started 12:14:30Z -> p95 dropped to ~420ms within 60s for affected hosts.
observability-bot: update: p95 now 460ms at 12:16Z; error_rate trending down. continuing to watch for 30m window.
pm_tom: customer impact note: we notified acme-inc support channel at 12:18Z and offered dedicated capacity failover. They accepted traffic reroute; CS to follow up.
cust_success_lee: acme-inc confirmed improvement after reroute, no further 504s.
sre_aly: recording timeline and handoff for RCA: I'll collect all traces, kernel package diffs, perf dumps and meet with eng-runtime for post-mortem at 14:00Z. tagging @eng_runtime_maya @eng_jordan
eng_runtime_maya: collecting `perf.data` and uploading S3 link: s3://redwood-incidents/3307212345/perf-host-gpu-12.tar.gz
eng_jordan: added raw spans + flamegraphs to the same bucket.
sre_aly: quick checklist for RCA thread: - exact kernel versions + pkg hashes - perf counters baseline vs impacted - batching/kv cache hit rates - deployment expansion timeline - affected host list - customer request ids
eng_jordan: early root-cause candidate: kernel scheduler change changed cfs quota behavior under our container cgroup mix -> increased CPU scheduling latency for GPU worker processes that coordinate batching. We'll validate with replay on a non-prod host.
pm_tom: communication: drafting incident update for customers; mark severity: Sev2. ETA for full RCA: EOD today.
eng_runtime_maya: handoff: I need a clean window to replay with older kernel. handing off to @sre_aly for live ops; I'll run mitigations + replay during afternoon slot.
sre_aly: oncall shift handoff: I'm on until 13:30Z then @eng_jordan covers. leaving notes here.
eng_jordan: ack, will continue traces and start replay on canary hosts at 13:05Z.
pm_tom: thanks team. I'll post status update in #status-page and notify account teams.
incident-bot: Incident update posted: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/3307212345
sre_aly: closing page for now — monitoring. reopen if p95 creeps back above 1000ms. :white_check_mark:
